historical_sanity_anchor: Japanese postwar estimates placed roughly forty Chinese divisions in IX War Area during the historical Changsha-Hengyang campaign; branch does not convert that nominal count directly into modern effective divisions.

command_logic.main_rule: Do not repeat a prestige defense that destroys the IX War Area command/heavy-weapons core inside Changsha.
command_logic.Changsha_local_role: Delay, demolition, urban denial and time purchase; not last-man fortress defense.
command_logic.reserve_role: Preserve forces south of Changsha so Japanese capture of one city does not automatically open Hengyang/Guangxi.
command_logic.political_constraint: Changsha cannot be abandoned without combat or demolition because of morale and symbolic value, but political value does not override preservation of the whole war area.

Chongqing_reaction: Release limited ammunition, signals, antitank and liaison support toward IX War Area, but no national all-in redeployment. North-Sichuan, Yunnan/Burma and internal-security claims remain binding.
next_gate: Determine whether the inner-system defense can hold Liuyang/Ningxiang long enough to evacuate Changsha assets and whether the city is isolated before 18 May.
